notes.note: Checked the scheduler section and actual dashboard query fixture. Pinned Collector, Prometheus and Grafana binaries over loopback admitted authenticated OTLP and evaluated the provisioned dashboard; the compose/container and deployed receipts remain separate.

Checked the infrastructure telemetry owner against the changed instrument declarations. The scheduler splits request observations from terminal executions under the existing OTel provider; no runtime, custody or event-log ownership changes.
Checked the Monitoring guide and declaration reference changes. Existing OTel and local monitoring boundaries remain separate, and the generated catalog remains a list of declarations.

Checked the scheduler and primary chat runtime owners. Built-in execution emits confirmed counters after durable settlement; request routes keep their existing admission. Primary chat owns the terminal status and end of its span, and finalization still owns measured token and duration attributes.
Checked the engine and runtime measurement contract. No Agent, request authority or installed-tool behavior changed. The updated descriptors report loaded maps and confirmed scheduler attempts.

Checked the scheduler route's exact attempt and authority claims. The route observation is now a dedicated counter; its order relative to admission and provider dispatch is unchanged, and the measured invocation does not replace the run receipt.
Checked scheduler management reachability and outcomes. The added management instrument measures dispatch observations; the route continues to rely on the existing service and authority callbacks.

Checked the direct-chat turn and Agent configuration lease references. Span finalization moves to the stream owner without changing configuration/approval, engine invocation or user-facing SSE behavior.

Checked Provider and runtime telemetry references. Provider instrumentation remains the same; the diagnostic dashboard distinguishes the existing attributes. No connection status or credential is synthesized.

Checked the counter/histogram populations, chart expressions and primary chat span lifecycle through real scheduler and chat callers. Local authenticated Collector to Prometheus/Grafana query evidence observes the exact execution statuses, management events, finite chat p95, absent route errors, and projected trace codes. Production and provider billing are unqualified.
Checked notification instrumentation against the shared declaration module. Existing notification recording and association stay the same; the dashboard uses the op label supplied by those callers.

Checked scheduler methods and primary chat SSE against the mutation. Authority, request and response shapes, refusal handling and health remain unchanged. Changes are only counting population and span outcome.

Checked scheduler invocation limits, retries and indeterminate run behavior against the execution owner. The configured timeouts, invocation admission and restart semantics stay as shipped; only confirmed outcomes contribute to execution telemetry.

Checked chat configuration and trace ownership against the stream site. The optional exporter still receives the configured context; the changed status handling introduces no environment variables or provider transport changes.

Regenerated the declaration catalog from the metrics module and verified it with the canonical check. The scheduler counter, elapsed-time descriptor, management counter, and map-size descriptions match their owners. Actual production caller exports were exercised separately.

Checked scheduled-job help against the built-in execution delta. The route, limits and user-observable run receipts retain their meaning. Telemetry identifies confirmed runs separately from management requests and does not alter execution.
